system.def: The object or group of objects you choose to study, inside a boundary you draw. Everything else is the surroundings.

surroundings.def: Everything outside the system you chose. Objects in the surroundings can push or pull on the system.

mass.def: A scalar measure of the amount of matter in an object, in kilograms (kg). The masses of parts add to the mass of the whole.

internal-structure.def: The parts inside a system and how they are arranged and move relative to each other. When it does not affect the question, the system can be modeled as one object.

center-of-mass.def: The mass-weighted average position of a system: x_cm = Σmᵢxᵢ ÷ Σmᵢ (the same for y). It lies on any line of symmetry of a uniform object, and the system moves as if all its mass were there.
